basic_info.description: Welcome to Tower Residence 413 at One Mission Bay. This lux one bedroom residence features: an amenities floor location, taller ceilings, wood flooring and like new high end finishes. The open concept great room includes a stunning gourmet kitchen showcasing premium Domus and Domus integrated cabinetry with matched refrigerator, dishwasher and island with seating and storage. The top of the line Gaggenau appliances include: a 5 burner gas cooktop and convection oven. The master bedroom suite features 2 closets and includes a walk-in closet. The ensuite bath has dual entrances with one entrance to the great room. The smart home tech includes central A/C. One Mission Bay is a full service building with 24/7 lobby ambassadors and concierge services. The life-style amenities include: a heated outdoor pool and hot tub, poolside cabanas, private outdoor dining and courtyard BBQ, resident lounge, private meeting room, biz center, library, guest suites, fitness center and more. Live walking distance to Oracle Park, Chase Center, Mission Creek, water front parks and walking trails, restaurants, Gus' Market and shopping. There's easy access to freeways and Cal Train. Live at One Mission Bay in Mission Bay, San Francisco's newest and most vibrant neighborhood.
